name: Fix red CI on main
description: Main's CI is red: read the failing run, fix every failure at the root on a branch (never by skipping or deleting tests), open a small PR and let it auto-merge, so every waiting PR can go green again.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: Failing jobs
inputs.default: every failing job of that run

data.brief:
CI on main is red: {{run}} (commit {{sha}}). Failing: {{jobs}}.
1. Read the failed steps' logs (gh run view --log-failed, or the kernel-test-reports artifact for Gradle). Note the exact failures.
2. Branch from origin/main (claude/ci-fix-{{stamp}}). Fix each failure at the root: the code, manifest, fixture generator or a stale test. Never skip, delete or loosen a test; if a fix truly needs Android hardware or work on hold, add a documented, tracked skip and say so.
3. A check may stop at its first failure: after each fix rerun the whole job's commands locally (CI env: AXF_BUILD_PROFILE=main-framework, AXF_DATA_DIR=off) until they pass.
4. Push the branch and open one small PR titled "Fix main CI: …"; the push banner auto-merges it once green. Do not merge it yourself.
Report each failure, its root cause, the fix, and the PR.
